medallia_new_record_trigger.description: Runs once for each new record in Medallia, answered or not, such as a transaction imported for surveying or an invitation sent. Records already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.fields: Beta. Each chosen field's raw values and labels lists, by field id.

output.labels: Beta. Each chosen field's display label, by field id.

parameters.description: Beta. Field ids to include for each record, separated by commas, such as e_ltr, e_email, e_unitid. Its date is always included.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: Beta. Only run for a record whose value in this field is one of the values given next, such as e_ltr. Leave blank to run for every one.
parameters.name: filter_field

parameters.description: Beta. The values to run for, separated by commas, such as 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 for detractors.
parameters.name: filter_values

medallia_new_response_trigger.description: Runs once for each new completed survey response in Medallia, or only those with the values you choose, such as a low likelihood to recommend: the way to follow up on a detractor or open a ticket. Responses already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.labels: Beta. Each chosen field's display label, by field id.
